nodes.title: Check question — Simple Machines at a Crane
nodes.why: One question on the idea just taught. A missed answer goes to a simpler re-teach step, then back here. Never scored against anyone.

check.q: A load moves further out along the boom. What does the chart allow?
check.why: A load further out turns the crane harder, so the chart allows less.

nodes.why: The adaptive step: the same idea in the station's own short step titles, then back to the check.

reteach: Find the simple machines in the crane.
Know the rule: never under a load.
Put the pulley test in order.
